title: A direct sum of an arbitrary family of projective modules is projective
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $I$ a set (possibly infinite or empty) and $(P_i)_{i\in I}$ a family of projective $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. Then the direct sum $\bigoplus_{i\in I}P_i$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-sum-modules] is a projective $R$-module.
